dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can count on the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: *sigh* I trust the Knights. Truly, I do. I just don't have any faith in Anselm's scrawny constitution.

dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: Every household has its own worries, doesn't it? Take the neighbors next door, for example. No one in their family went on the expedition, and yet they're still constantly fretting over their daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: Their daughter... Mona, I believe? I hear she's renting a place in Mondstadt now, making a living reading fortunes for people.

dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: Her family's well-off, too, but she still refuses to live with her parents. Always on the move, always busy... Different strokes for different folks, as they say.
